correctness.rationale: Direct integration yields off-diagonals F(g)/ell1 and F(H−g)/ell2, with F a positive Laplace transform weighted by bounded positive b(k). The Perron eigenvalue is increasing in F(g)F(H−g), independent of fixed positive site multipliers. Holder yields log-convexity with strictness exactly for non-Dirac mixing; symmetric strictly convex h(g)=logF(g)+logF(H−g) has midpoint unique minimum and contact maxima. With one rate, F(g)F(H−g) is constant; for any number of reserves M(g)=D(g) C D(g)^−1, so full spectrum invariant. Our independent numerical double integration agrees with the Perron formula within 1e-6, with touching/equal growth approximately 0.347057/0.315728.
residual_risks: Bounded finite verification alone cannot prove the universal claim; symbolic proof reconstruction is the principal support.

final_claim: For two finite positive-width habitat reserves on a directed circular coast with any probability mixture of wrapped exponential rates, the linear recruitment Perron root is uniquely minimized at equal gaps and maximized at contact iff mixing is non-Dirac; every pure exponential is gap-neutral, and for arbitrary many reserves its complete characteristic polynomial is gap independent.
